items.source: Flux deserialized via decode(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map) are not supported because the Protobuf Java Util library does not provide a non-blocking parser that splits a JSON stream into tokens. Applications should consider decoding to Mono<Message> or Mono<List<Message>>, which will use the supported decodeToMono(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map).
items.translation: 通过 `decode(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map)` 反序列化的 Flux 不受支持，因为 Protobuf Java Util 库不提供将 JSON 流拆分为标记的非阻塞解析器。应用程序应考虑解码为 `Mono<Message>` 或 `Mono<List<Message>>`，这将使用受支持的 `decodeToMono(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map)`。

items.source: This decoder requires Protobuf 3.29 or higher, and supports "application/json" and "application/*+json" with the official "com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java-util" library.
items.translation: 该解码器需要 Protobuf 3.29 或更高版本，并支持使用官方 `"com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java-util"` 库的 `"application/json"` 和 `"application/*+json"`。

items.source: Return the list of MIME types supported by this Decoder. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canDecode(elementType, null). The list may also exclude MIME types supported only for a specific element type. Alternatively, use Decoder.getDecodableMimeTypes(ResolvableType) for a more precise list.
items.translation: 返回此 Decoder 支持的 MIME 类型列表。该列表可能不适用于所有可能的目标元素类型，因此调用此方法时通常应通过 canDecode(elementType, null) 进行防护。该列表也可能仅包含针对特定元素类型支持的 MIME 类型。或者，使用 Decoder.getDecodableMimeTypes(ResolvableType) 获取更精确的列表。
